Bumped the package to `1.3.0` (a purely additive, backward-compatible minor release) since it's published and external callers pin/upgrade independently.

## Summary

Added `slantDistance` to `src/index.ts`:
- New `Reading` interface extends `Point` with a `height` (metres) field.
- Refactored the existing flat-earth projection math out of `distance` into an internal `groundDistance` helper (unrounded), so both functions share it without double-rounding error.
- `slantDistance(a: Reading, b: Reading)` combines the ground distance and the height difference via Pythagoras (`Math.hypot`), rounded to whole metres.
- `distance`/`Point`'s existing signatures are untouched — safe for external callers upgrading independently.

Added three tests in `src/index.test.ts` alongside the existing ones: equal-height readings match `distance`, same-location readings differ only by height, and a 3-4-5-style right-triangle check. Verified with `node --test 'src/**/*.test.ts'` directly — all 6 tests pass (exit 0). Note: `npm test` itself exits 255 with no output in this sandboxed shell — that's an npm/sandbox environment quirk unrelated to the code, since the identical underlying `node --test` command runs clean.
